s01607.summary: Archie, Penelope and Barnaby banter about firefly catching on the porch.
Penelope lunges with her net, the jar drops and the fireflies escape.
The children marvel at fireflies in the yard while Archie whittles on.

s02424.summary: Staff run the hyperbaric treatment while Aram rests inside and Lenka waits.
Lenka asks how long; Sigrid and Tembo reassure her about her father.
The gauge ticks and Barry realizes the supply line is failing.
Sigrid and Tembo work the valve and tell Lenka it is routine.
Barry clamps the leaking coupling with bare hands until Sigrid shuts the valve.
Relief floods the room; Aram signals he is fine and Lenka sinks into a chair.

s01190.summary: Cordelia connects calls at the board while Mrs. Fenwick watches.
Captain Warrington demands the Admiralty; Cordelia resists Mrs. Fenwick's order to disconnect.
Warrington reports a harbor fire and Mrs. Fenwick orders everyone rung.

s01339.summary: Quinn examines a dead man's gloved hand among lilies in the cold room.
Captain Wren phones to warn Quinn the furious florist is coming.
Quinn freezes as the latch clicks and the door swings open.

s00037.summary: Six thieves enter the dinosaur hall and begin their heist.
Renata pries the lock and Gustav swaps the egg as a click echoes.
The crew hides as the guard strolls in, blames pigeons, and leaves.
The crew regroups and files out with the real egg.

s01223.summary: Three survivors shelter by an overturned truck with almost no water.
They argue over distance and whether to walk now or wait for dusk.
A distant sound and glare appear, and Corazón signals with her mirror.
A quad bike stops nearby and the rider raises a hand.
Junior breaks down laughing; Dash steadies Corazón and they share the last water.

s02208.summary: Fired Audrey sits in her car as colleagues awkwardly say farewell.
Audrey laughs at Nathaniel's honest reply, leaves the fern, and drives away.

s01217.summary: Detective Imani confronts Toby and Serafina over the stabbed groom.
Toby shields Serafina, saying Callum attacked her; Callum calls her a liar.
Weapons are lowered and Imani tends Callum's wound as a siren nears.

s00769.summary: Halvard rests his dogs at the checkpoint while the vet examines Aurora.
Race control reports rival Delacroix withdrawn after his team fell through ice.
Halvard considers quitting, then resolves to continue without hurrying.

s00916.summary: Inspector Logan questions housekeeper Odile about the locked-room death and the key.
Davies spots a brass key in the shattered glass, and Logan eyes Odile.

s00946.summary: Odalys and Marcellus meet in the funicular; he demands what she carries.
The car stalls mid-slope and Marcellus insists she show him.
Odalys draws a revolver; Marcellus reveals a sword cane and she cocks the hammer.

s00966.summary: Horatia begins her last broadcast, recalling a caller she turned away decades ago.
She plays the silent tape of the caller's breathing.
Horatia apologizes to the murdered girl and signs off.

s02112.summary: Cheeseworks executives stand crammed in an elevator that will not move.
Lights flicker and the CEO tells the intern Francesca to fill out a form.

s02464.summary: Five people sit stalled in a gondola as base promises a forty-minute wait.
Frightened Pearl asks for her mom; Lotte comforts her, and Ravenna refuses the brandy.
Kwame hums, Lorenzo admits fear of heights, and Kwame shares his earbud with Pearl.
The gondola drops six inches and everyone panics.
The cable lurches and the gondola glides toward the valley, relieved passengers exhaling.

s02332.summary: Sister Agnieszka tends wounded Sergeant Brantley and they talk quietly in the ruined opera ward.
She sees his dog tags and notes his English name.
She retreats behind the curtain and draws a pistol from her habit.

s00345.summary: A patrol crouches on a paddy dike, bickering softly as Lin spots contact.
Gunfire sends everyone flat; they squabble over using cornflakes code.
Hargreave radios, then leads the squad running down the dike into the fog.

s01001.summary: Residents trade small talk in an orbital launderette until Vashti calls for calm.
A hull breach klaxon sounds and the group fixates on bulging dryer six.
A soapy cat bursts from the dryer and clings to deadpan Vashti.

s01359.summary: Clerks work the telegraph office as Ashdown announces delays on the Atlantic cable.
Ashdown confirms the delay is the Titanic; Harriet mourns her stoker brother.
Rosalind reports Carpathia picked up survivors and names are to follow.
Rosalind keys again and begins reading the first names aloud.

s02439.summary: Stranded Amos writes a letter to Ruth about the broken wheel and lost water.
He searches the horizon, finds nothing, and resigns himself to wait for the stars.
A distant bell rings and Amos walks toward it with an empty canteen.

s01619.summary: Five guests climb into the attic to find whatever has been tapping.
Taps build, the dummy topples and a shape bursts through the skylight.
They call it a gull and go to bed, but Thomas hears another tap.

s00305.summary: A stranger apologizes to baker Penny for a harsh one-star review of her rye.
Perpetua reveals she is the reviewer and waits for the bread, sharing toast.

s01821.summary: Six teammates wait silently in a dead rink for the seventh.
Nadia skates, resents sponsor's nephew Lucas, and Tomás and Dee needle him.
Coach puts Lucas on line one; Nadia tears off her captain's C.
Nadia checks Lucas into the boards and Tomás restrains her as the lights die.

s01228.summary: Ozzie rehearses with two singers and covers for absent Margit.
A phone call from Margit at the hospital brings Ozzie quiet news.
Ozzie speaks of bells and strikes the largest bell as the singers rise.

s01931.summary: Nadia questions why lot forty-one's ticket was reprinted from attributed to signed.
She examines the clock with a loupe and presses staff about the courier.
Nadia says she will bid tomorrow and leaves, with the others fearing she knows.

s00609.summary: Kamau and his men watch the valley from a ruined tower; Reyes radios in.
Kamau orders frightened Santos to eat and the men talk about home.
Distant mortars thump; they wait and learn the road is the target.
Santos asks about a hot bath and Kamau jokes it will be the next war.
